violation_type.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))
violation_type.short_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report
violation_type.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that the operation staff was notified of possible abuse against a child in care and the operation did not report to licensing.

finding_variants.text: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that the operation staff was notified of possible abuse against a child in care and the operation did not report to licensing.
Based on the evidence obtained during a DFPS investigation, a staff member delegated and failed to report suspected abuse/neglect within the required 48 hours.
During an investigation it was found that two allegations of prohibited punshiments were reported to the operation but was not reported to Child Care Regulation.
Child Care Investigator stated that the operation fell to report suspect abuse/neglect or incident that placed children at risk to Child Care Regulation.
It was determined that the operation did not report suspected abuse of a 2 year old child in care on January 12th, 2022.
The provider failed to report suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation directly to the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline in a timely manner.
